An '''energy potion''' restores 15% of the player's run [[energy]] per dose. It can be made at level 26 [[Herblore]] by mixing a [[harralander]] in a [[vial of water]] and then adding [[chocolate dust]], granting 67.5 Herblore experience. 

After [[Barbarian Training#Barbarian Herblore|Barbarian Herblore Training]], [[caviar]] can be added to a 2 dose energy potion, which requires 29 Herblore and yields a 2 dose [[energy mix]] and 14 Herblore experience. An [[energy mix]] heals 3 [[hitpoints]] in addition to restoring 15% run energy.

It can be purchased from [[Apothecary's Potions]] in Varrock for 1 [[chocolate dust]] and 2 [[limpwurt roots]], obtained from [[Dr Jekyll]] in exchange for a [[ranarr weed]], or obtained as a common drop from various early game monsters, such as [[goblin]]s, [[dark wizard]]s, NPCs with the standard "human" drop table such as [[men]], and low level [[Slayer]] monsters.

{{Subject changes header}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 19 August 2026
|update = Summer Sweep Up - Hunter & Skilling
|change =  * Energy potions now restore 15% of [[run energy]] per dose, up from 10%.
* Various low level [[NPC]]s now drop 1- to 3-dose energy potions. These include:
** [[Dark wizard]]s
** [[Goblin]]s
** [[Molanisk]]s
** [[Desert Lizard]]s
** [[Banshee]]s
** [[Cave crawler]]s
** [[Cockatrice]]s
** [[Crawling hand]]s
** [[Killerwatt]]s
** NPCs with the standard "human" drop such as [[men]], [[women]], [[Al Kharid warrior]]s, or [[rogue]]s
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 29 May 2025
|update = Yama CAs & More!
|change = Energy potions have been exempted from the [[Grand Exchange#Convenience fee and item sink|Grand Exchange convenience fee]].
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 9 March 2017
|update = General QoL!
|change = The item was made available to free-to-play players.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 15 April 2016
|update = Bank Placeholder Feedback Changes
|change = Half full potions could now be turned into bank placeholders.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 26 October 2004
|update = Treasure Trails and Changes
|change = An "Empty" option was added.
}}
{{Subject changes footer}}

==Trivia==
*As potions are a part of the members-only Herblore skill, they had been members-only items since their creation. They were made accessible to free players on [[9 March]] [[2017]].
